title: Stones Laid Without a Sound
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
King Solomon would build a house
For God, the very best.
With cedar wood and shining gold,
Smooth stones and all the rest.

[Chorus]
Give God your very best each day,
In all you say and do.
Your best at school, your best at home,
And He'll be pleased with you.

[Verse 2]
They shaped the stones so far away,
Then laid them without sound.
For seven years, no hammer rang
Upon that holy ground.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, my builder small,
Your work today is through.
Heavenly Father's here tonight,
And He is proud of you.

[Chorus]
mood: Building music. A calm, measured pulse lays itself down under the voice one beat at a time, like smooth stones set quietly in place, patient and unhurried, matching seven years of careful work for God. The chorus grows a little fuller, like gold catching light in a finished room. By the last verse the pulse slows and settles lower, the tools set down, the quiet of a holy place at night.
